def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    objs=[]
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c]!=bg and not seen[r][c]:
                st=[(r,c)]; comp=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop()
                    if seen[a][b]: continue
                    seen[a][b]=True; comp.append((a,b))
                    for dr in (-1,0,1):
                        for dc in (-1,0,1):
                            x,y=a+dr,b+dc
                            if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and g[x][y]==g[r][c] and not seen[x][y]: st.append((x,y))
                objs.append((g[r][c],comp))
    def norm(cl):
        rs=[r for r,_ in cl]; cs=[c for _,c in cl]
        return tuple(sorted((r-min(rs),c-min(cs)) for r,c in cl))
    pairs=[(o1,o2) for o1,o2 in itertools.combinations(objs,2) if o1[0]!=o2[0] and norm(o1[1])==norm(o2[1])]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    if not pairs: return out
    o1,o2=pairs[0]
    c1=(sum(r for r,_ in o1[1])/len(o1[1]), sum(c for _,c in o1[1])/len(o1[1]))
    c2=(sum(r for r,_ in o2[1])/len(o2[1]), sum(c for _,c in o2[1])/len(o2[1]))
    d1=(c1[0]-c2[0])**2+(c1[1]-c2[1])**2; d2=(o2[1] and (c2[0]-c1[0])**2+(c2[1]-c1[1])**2) if False else (c2[0]-c1[0])**2+(c2[1]-c1[1])**2
    far,other=(o1,o2) if d1>d2 else (o2,o1)
    cands=sorted({o[0] for o,_ in objs if o not in (far[0],other[0])})
    far[1]=[0]*h
    for i,row in enumerate(out):
        far[1][i]=[0]*w
    # recolor
    for r,c in far[1]: out[r][c]=cands[0]
    return out

def f(g):
    objs=comps(g)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    cnt={o['col']:sum(1 for x in objs if x['col']==o['col']) for o in objs}
    singles=[o for o in objs if cnt[o['col']]==1]
    groups={}
    for o in objs:
        k=tuple(sorted((r-min(r for r,c in o['cells']),c-min(c for r,c in o['cells'])) for r,c in o['cells']))
        groups.setdefault(k,[]).append(o)
    best=None; bestd=-1
    for lst in groups.values():
        if len(lst)<2: continue
        for o1,o2 in itertools.combinations(lst,2):
            if o1['col']!=o2['col'] and len(o1['cells'])>1 and len(o2['cells'])>1:
                sz=len(o1['cells'])+len(o2['cells'])
                if sz>bestsz:
                    bestd=sz; p=(o1,o2)
    tgt=max(singles,key=lambda o:len(o['cells']))
    d1=(ctr(p[0]['cells'])[0]-ctr(tgt['cells'])[0])**2+(ctr(p[0]['cells'])[1]-ctr(tgt['cells'])[1])**2
    d2=(ctr(p[1]['cells'])[0]-ctr(tgt['cells'])[0])**2+(ctr(p[1]['cells'])[1]-ctr(tgt['cells'])[1])**2
    chobj=p[0] if d1>d2 else p[1]
    for r,c in chobj['cells']: out[r][c]=tgt['col']
    return out

def canon(cells):
    pts=[(r,c) for r,c in cells]
    mr=min(r for r,_ in pts); mc=min(c for _,c in pts)
    pts=[(r-mr,c-mc) for r,c in pts]
    def t(pts,name):
        yield name,pts
        yield name+'R',[ (c,-r) for r,c in pts]
        yield name+'F',[( -r,c) for r,c in pts]
        yield name+'RF',[(-c,r) for r,c in pts]
        yield name+'RT',[(-r,-c) for r,c in pts]
        yield name+'L',[(-c,r) for r,c in pts]
        yield name+'FL',[(r,-c) for r,c in pts]
    best=None
    for nm,ps in t(pts,'t'):
        k=tuple(sorted(ps))
        if best is None or k<best: best=k
    return best

def f(g):
    objs=comps(g)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    cnt={o['col']:sum(1 for x in objs if x['col']==o['col']) for o in objs}
    singles=[o for o in objs if cnt[o['col']]==1]
    tgt=max(singles,key=lambda o:len(o['cells']))
    tgtc=tgt['col']; tgtcells=tgt['cells']
    groups={}
    for o in objs:
        k=tuple(sorted((r-min(r for r,c in o['cells']),c-min(c for r,c in o['cells'])) for r,c in o['cells']))
        groups.setdefault(k,[]).append(o)
    best=None; bg=-1
    for lst in groups.values():
        if len(lst)<2: continue
        for o1,o2 in itertools.combinations(lst,2):
            if o1['col']!=o2['col'] and len(o1['cells'])>1 and len(o2['cells'])>1:
                s=len(o1['cells'])+len(o2['cells'])
                if s>bg: bg=s; best=(o1,o2)
    if best is None: return out
    a,b=best
    ga=min(abs(r1-r2)+abs(c1-c2) for r1,c1 in a['cells'] for r2,c2 in tgtcells)
    gb=min(abs(r1-r2)+abs(c1-c2) for r1,c1 in b['cells'] for r2,c2 in tgtcells)
    ch=a if ga>=gb else b
    for r,c in ch['cells']: out[r][c]=tgtc
    return out

def f(g):
    objs=comps(g)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    cnt={o['col']:sum(1 for x in objs if x['col']==o['col']) for o in objs}
    singles=[o for o in objs if cnt[o['col']]==1]
    tgt=max(singles,key=lambda o:len(o['cells']))
    tgtc=tgt['col']; tgtcells=tgt['cells']
    groups={}
    for o in objs:
        k=tuple(sorted((r-min(r for r,c in o['cells']),c-min(c for r,c in o['cells'])) for r,c in o['cells']))
        groups.setdefault(k,[]).append(o)
    p=None; best=-1
    for lst in groups.values():
        if len(lst)<2: continue
        for o1,o2 in itertools.combinations(lst,2):
            if o1['col']!=o2['col'] and len(o1['cells'])>1 and len(o2['cells'])>1:
                s=len(o1['cells'])+len(o2['cells'])
                if s>best: best=s; p=(o1,o2)
    if p is None: return out
    ga=min(abs(r1-r2)+abs(c1-c2) for r1,c1 in p[0]['cells'] for r2,c2 in tgtcells)
    gb=min(abs(r1-r2)+abs(c1-c2) for r1,c1 in p[1]['cells'] for r2,c2 in tgtcells)
    ch=p[0] if ga>=gb else p[1]
    for r,c in ch['cells']: out[r][c]=tgtc
    return out

def variants(cells):
    rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
    mr,mc=min(rs),min(cs)
    rel=[(r-mr,c-mc) for r,c in cells]
    out=set()
    cur=rel
    for _ in range(2):
        for t in (lambda p:(p[1],p[0]), lambda p:(-p[1],p[0])):
            cur=t(cur)
            mr,mc=min(r for r,c in cur),min(c for r,c in cur)
            out.add(frozenset((r-mr,c-mc) for r,c in cur))
        cur=[(-r,c) for r,c in cur]
    return out
